military/camps.title: Military camp
military/camps.lead: Prefabricated softwall shelters and expandable containers engineered for mobility and redeployment by militaries stationed in remote locations. Each camp is customized to your operational requirements, location, transport logistics and budget.

sections.h: For troops stationed around the world
p: The Canadian Forces deployed a 2,000-person Weatherhaven camp in Afghanistan. It was transported to site by air and sea, and designed to provide comfort through Kabul’s harsh summer and winter months.

Weatherhaven’s prefabricated softwall shelters and expandable containers are engineered for seamless mobility and redeployment for militaries stationed in remote locations anywhere on Earth. Domestic and international militaries and governments rely on Weatherhaven for shelter and camp capability that improves the safety, comfort and performance of their personnel.

The expandable containers (MECC, EHMECC, HERCon and TRECC) can be pre-wired and pre-plumbed, with electrical and mechanical systems installed in the central core, so you can be fully operational quickly.

sections.h: Equipped with the systems you need
p: Weatherhaven provides all the shelter systems and camp components you require. Softwall shelter systems are integrated once your shelters are erected on site. Most are pre-assembled at the factory and have quick-connect fittings for fast installation. Systems include:
list: Ablutions
Kitchens
Laundry (batch and self-serve)
Sleeping quarters
Electrical kits
Power generation and distribution
Water filtration, storage and distribution
Waste management
Camp security
Fire protection
Furnishings and interiors
Floors (fabric and hard floor systems)
Ancillary equipment: Solarshades, interconnector kits, corridors, mobilizers and trailers

sections.h: Military camps as specialized as your mission
p: Each military camp is customized to suit your operational requirements, location, transport logistics and budget. Weatherhaven’s designers and engineers work with you to make sure everything meets your specifications.
Before designing your camp, we consider factors including:
list: Geographical location and climate
Type of deployment: tactical, semi-permanent or permanent
Transportation and logistics
Number and types of occupants
Term and duration of occupancy
Relocation capability required
Compliance with relevant codes
Special operational requirements

sections.h: Any size or type of camp
p: Weatherhaven can manufacture any size or type of military camp, from simple accommodation shelters to fully integrated stand-alone units such as kitchens, ablutions and command posts.
A complete turnkey camp can consist of:
list: Softwall shelters only
Expandable containers only
Expandable containers combined with fabric structures

p: On a time-sensitive military operation, quick deployment and redeployment are essential to mission success. Weatherhaven’s military camps and systems are engineered for turnkey operation and easy maintenance.
From camp design to maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), our team handles all your military shelter needs and works with you to deliver a redeployable shelter capability that suits your mission.

military/c2.title: Command and control
military/c2.lead: Weatherhaven’s expandable containers provide space for a technical command and control centre. They deploy in rugged field conditions, set up quickly on uneven terrain and protect sensitive electronic equipment from the elements.

sections.h: Military shelters for tactical command and control
p: Today’s military missions are complex and dynamic, with shrinking windows of response time. Meeting them with agility requires functional mobile command posts and control centres.
Weatherhaven’s expandable containers (MECC, EHMECC, TRECC and HERCon) provide space for a technical command and control centre. They:
list: Can be deployed in rugged field conditions and set up quickly on uneven terrain
Protect sensitive electronic equipment from the elements. Equipment is stored and transported in the centre core and does not need to be removed during set-up or tear-down
Offer various electrical and mechanical interfaces, and connect to other Weatherhaven expandable containers and softwall shelters to form a tactical command centre
Can be outfitted with custom electrical packages, including outlets and data ports for radios, computers and other equipment
Allow over-pressurization of the unit to protect against dust and other contaminants, such as CBRN agents
Protect personnel and equipment in all weather, including extreme heat, high humidity, snow and hail

p: The capability extends beyond the shelter platform to the electrical and mechanical systems for command and control, such as fibre optics, CAT 5 and video conferencing.
Weatherhaven can also provide interior furnishings, such as:
list: Server racks
Desks
Map boards
TV screens

sections.h: Three levels of CBRN force protection
p: An army deployment may need to extract itself from a contaminated environment. CBRN force protection is applied across three levels of capability:
list: Integral support: carried out at the personal level (for example, respirators and detectors) to ensure individual survival and continued support to the operation
Close support: maintains or restores operational tempo within a short period, beyond simple survival skills such as reconnaissance, surveillance and hazard avoidance
General support: thorough vehicle and equipment decontamination, plus sampling and identification

p: Weatherhaven provides full CBRN decontamination and protection, including mobile shelters and all the necessary systems. Militaries and humanitarian organizations can decontaminate equipment, vehicles, personnel and civilians, then take refuge in a clean and safe environment.
list: With special liners and air-filtration units added, the shelters can be used for decontamination, so medical personnel can treat patients exposed to toxic CBRN agents.
Softwall shelters use Chemical Agent Resistant Material (CARM) fabrics. Expandable shelters use Chemical Agent Resistant Coating (CARC) paint.
Everything needed for CBRN decontamination can be sourced and provided by Weatherhaven, from showers to berms, airlocks, recirc filters and decontaminant foam.
The solution minimizes water usage and captures washing, decontamination and rinsing fluids for disposal.

p: Weatherhaven’s engineering and design teams work with you during configuration to choose the shelter components that best meet your needs. Common requirements include:
list: Power, phone, radio and LAN connections
Custom exterior hookups
Custom interconnection configurations
Personnel access and egress requirements
Mobilization and mounting characteristics
Heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC)
Exterior finish characteristics
Cargo security
Partitioning
Cable and ducting ports
CBRN capability
Stand-alone container capability with integrated HVAC and power

p: From command post design to equipment, shipping logistics and installation, our team handles all your military shelter requirements and works with you to deliver a redeployable shelter capability that fits your operation.

military/workshops.title: Workshops
military/workshops.lead: First-line and second-line maintenance workshops, custom configured to user requirements and deployment scenarios. They range from softwall shelters for long-term deployment to expandable containers with built-in generators and HVAC for tactical and short-term operations.

p: Weatherhaven’s first-line and second-line maintenance workshops are custom configured to meet user requirements and deployment scenarios. Options range from a softwall shelter for long-term deployment to an integrated expandable container with built-in generators and HVAC for tactical and short-term operations.
All workshops can be deployed on the ground. The expandable container can also be set up and operated on the back of a truck or trailer for complete mobility.
Weatherhaven shelters provide the space and functionality for first-line and second-line maintenance in deployed aircraft and vehicle operations. Users can perform:
list: Non-destructive inspection
Maintenance, repair, inspection and/or fabrication of aircraft or vehicle components made from a variety of metals and alloys
Hydraulics and pneumatics work
Support verification testing and repair of avionic and electronic systems and equipment
Repair of rotor and powertrain components
On-aircraft repairs and maintenance for paint and composite work

p: Weatherhaven’s Tire Maintenance Facility (TMF) lets military personnel safely change run-flats in theatre instead of shipping tires back to the host country for repair. It increases functionality, improves work conditions and reduces expenditures.
Within a MECC or Extended Height MECC TMF, you can:
list: Reduce operational expenses and increase productivity
Change almost every tire in the military inventory and repair tires wherever you deploy, in a safe and comfortable environment
Deploy within 30 minutes, without special training or tools

p: As a complement to the MECC TMF, the MECC Tire Storage Facility includes special racks to hold and store armoured fighting vehicle tires.
A well-provisioned tool crib is crucial for military vehicle deployment and fleet maintenance. Weatherhaven’s MECC Tool Crib is:
list: Self-contained and quick to deploy, with maximum service life and minimal maintenance
Suited to garrison and field deployment
Designed to ISO specifications
CSC certified for air, land or sea transport and stacking
Fitted with rugged anchor fittings for secure movement of heavily laden tool cabinets
Easy for non-technical operators to set up
Equipped with quick-connect fittings at all hookups for rapid deployment
Operable in all climates
Easy to level on uneven terrain
Fitted with tool cabinets whose drawers are fully expandable when completely loaded, with sub-dividers to aid organization and prevent damage in transport

p: The Redeployable Field Workshop is a single-shelter platform that supports a number of maintenance functions, including electronic repair. Features include:
list: Rapid set-up and configuration
Designed to ISO specifications
CSC certified for air, land or sea transport
Operable in all climates
Rugged construction and anchor hardware secure internal equipment and machinery
Equipment is stored and shipped in the centre core, so sensitive electronics such as radar test bed equipment and circuit boards are not exposed to the weather
Custom furnishings, special equipment, and electrical and mechanical details are designed to your specific repair requirements
Double doors can be installed for the repair of large equipment and parts

p: From workshop design to equipment, shipping logistics and installation, our team handles all your military shelter requirements and works with you to deliver a redeployable shelter capability that suits your mission.

military/simulation.title: Simulation and training
military/simulation.lead: When full-scale military exercises are not feasible, Weatherhaven’s MECC and EHMECC expandable containers can be integrated with simulation equipment to train more personnel at reduced cost.

sections.h: When full-scale military exercises aren’t feasible
p: Simulation and training is a growing military requirement, driven by budget cuts and the demand to train as many personnel as possible at reduced cost.
In response, Weatherhaven developed the methodology and skills to meet user requirements with its existing line of expandable containers.
Weatherhaven’s MECC and Extended Height MECC (EHMECC) can be integrated with simulation equipment. They:
list: Provide three times the floor space of a regular ISO container, with the EHMECC extending an additional 4.5 feet for a spacious interior for workflow traffic and equipment
Can be manufactured based on a container height of 8 ft, 8 ft 6 in or 9 ft 6 in
Provide a well-lit, comfortable working environment
Are easy to maintain in the field or on a base
Can be outfitted with simulation equipment mounted in the centre core for ease of deployment, or wheel-mounted and moved into place after set-up
Are CSC certified, so they can be loaded by forklift, crane or PLS and transported anywhere in the world by aircraft, truck, trailer or ship
Can be equipped for After Action Review
Are custom designed for deployment in any environment

sections.h: Full service: design to post-project support
p: From shelter design to shipping logistics, equipment and repair, our team handles all your military shelter needs and works with you to deliver a redeployable shelter capability that suits your operation.

military/uav.title: Unmanned aerial vehicles and satellite systems
military/uav.lead: Mobile shelters for UAV ground control stations and maintenance workshops, and expandable containers that house the hardware to receive and process satellite imagery and data.

p: Militaries and Special Operations Forces use UAVs for surveillance and intelligence gathering. Weatherhaven can support a UAV operation with mobile shelters for:
list: Ground control stations
UAV maintenance workshops for in-service support (ISS)

p: Dynamic, area-wide surveillance is crucial for many military operations. Weatherhaven’s expandable containers are versatile, flexible and easy to maintain for satellite systems applications.
The expandable containers (MECC, EHMECC, TRECC and HERCon):
list: House the hardware and support equipment needed to receive and process satellite imagery and data from multiple remote-sensing satellites
Can be transported cost-effectively to virtually any location by truck, trailer, rail, aircraft, helicopter or ship
Are custom designed around your concept of operations for deployment in any environment

p: Weatherhaven’s engineering and design teams assist with the design configuration, layout and integration of your mobile shelters, from concept to completion.
A dedicated parts and service department provides after-sales support, including spares and tool kits, and complete maintenance, repair and overhaul.
From shelter design to shipping logistics, installation and maintenance, our team handles all your mobile shelter needs.

medical/field-hospitals.title: Field hospitals
medical/field-hospitals.lead: Fully equipped mobile field hospitals, from 10 beds to hundreds of beds with specialized medical equipment, engineered to function in remote locations for commercial, military and emergency response applications.

p: Weatherhaven engineers, manufactures and installs fully equipped mobile field hospitals, designed for specific levels of medical care and operational requirements.

Whether you need 10 hospital beds or hundreds of beds and specialized medical equipment, the facilities are engineered to function in remote locations for commercial, military and emergency response applications.
Weatherhaven’s medical shelter solutions meet the guidelines and standards for the use of foreign field hospitals set by organizations such as the World Health Organization and the United Nations.

First aid shelters are an essential and mandatory feature of any code-compliant workforce camp. Portable triage centres may also be needed for immediate medical care, minor surgery, or to stabilize patients before evacuation to larger medical facilities.

A comprehensive medical set-up is crucial when responding to natural disasters, civil unrest or warfare. Combining expandable containers and fabric shelters, Weatherhaven’s Level I, Level II and Level III mobile medical facilities enable full medical care for militaries and government agencies around the world.

sections.h: First aid and triage shelters (Level I)
p: First aid and triage shelters are the first stop for receiving, diagnosing and treating patients. They are redeployable, have ample floor space for various configurations, and function much like a doctor’s office with basic medical care:
list: Doctors and nurses assess patients, assign treatment priorities and initiate medical documentation
Patients with severe illnesses or injuries are stabilized until transfer to a medical facility with surgical and patient-holding capabilities

p: During military missions and civilian emergency response, a full surgical set-up is crucial. Doctors and nurses need a temperature-controlled, hygienic and fully enclosed medical complex:
list: Shelters link to each other, or to a central corridor, to form a completely contained facility
Patients and hospital staff move throughout the surgical centre without exposure to weather, with easy access from the central corridor
The central corridor can also be used for patient overflow and equipment storage

p: Military field hospitals are configured to meet specific operational requirements and levels of care. From triage to resuscitation, surgery and post-operative care, Level III field hospitals are designed to deliver medical care to military and government personnel, and to civilian populations around the world.
Weatherhaven also offers the following, all of which can be housed in softwall or expandable container shelters:
list: Camps for hospital staff
Ablutions and washhouses
Kitchens
Dining halls
Laundry

p: Weatherhaven provides an operating room shelter solution that no one else can. The patent-protected Extended Height Mobile Expandable Container Capability (EHMECC) extends an additional 4.5 feet in height. The spacious interior allows extra headroom, a higher-hanging operating room lamp and a climate-controlled working environment.
Our team handles all your mobile field hospital needs, from initial hospital design to shipping logistics and installation, equipment, and repair and overhaul.

medical/clinics.title: Medical clinics
medical/clinics.lead: Mobile clinics that bring medical care to civilians, camp occupants and military personnel in remote areas. They can be configured or reconfigured by adding or removing components or changing interior layouts.

sections.h: Bringing medical clinics to the field
p: Weatherhaven’s mobile clinics support medical care for civilians, camp occupants and military personnel in remote areas around the world, whether you are a humanitarian handling an Ebola outbreak in Africa or a military doctor who needs a dental clinic.

The clinics can be configured or reconfigured to suit your exact specifications and environmental conditions, by adding or removing components or changing the interior layout. They are engineered for a wide range of medical applications.

list: Reception and examination
Injury care and stabilization
Diagnosing and treating patients
Dental
Ophthalmology
Gynecology
Vaccination
Medical equipment supply
X-ray

medical/emergency.title: Emergency response
medical/emergency.lead: Custom disaster response shelters designed to your operational needs and budget, for emergencies of any scale, from earthquakes and floods to hurricanes and epidemics.

sections.h: Designed for disasters of any scale
p: After the earthquake in Haiti, Canada deployed part of its Weatherhaven-manufactured field hospital. It was operational in 24 hours and provided medical treatment and care to the civilian population.

International disasters and their humanitarian impact call for an immediate response. Our team works with you to design custom disaster response shelters that meet your operational needs and budget, and helps you prepare for emergencies of any magnitude, from earthquakes and floods to hurricanes and epidemics.
Weatherhaven’s softwall shelters and expandable containers can be outfitted for a variety of emergency response and disaster preparedness situations, including:
list: Command and control centres
Medical staff camps
Humanitarian aid
Triage and first aid
Surgical centres
Fully equipped hospitals
Securing equipment and transporting supplies
Custom cases to transport medical equipment securely to site

p: During an emergency, your time is best spent on damage control. Weatherhaven handles the logistics, from need assessment and shelter design to equipment, shipping logistics and installation, and works with you to deliver a redeployable shelter capability that fits your requirements.

medical/cbrn.title: CBRN protection and decontamination
medical/cbrn.lead: Mobile shelters and systems for full CBRN decontamination and protection, so militaries and humanitarian organizations can decontaminate equipment, vehicles, personnel and civilians.

sections.h: Your defence against chemical and biological threats
p: More than a decade into the 21st century, the proliferation of CBRN weapons continues to be among the most pressing threats to global peace and security.

You could be on the front lines responding to a biological attack, or a humanitarian handling civilian exposure to a toxic chemical agent. In both scenarios, a mobile shelter for CBRN decontamination can save lives.
CBRN protection must safeguard against exposure and support first aid treatment and decontamination of CBRN agents and casualties. For CBRN defence, military personnel must be capable of:
list: Providing safe, effective and licensed medical countermeasures to potentially exposed personnel
Safely evacuating casualties from CBRN-contaminated areas, and providing a clean, toxic-free environment for people and equipment

sections.h: Three levels of CBRN force protection
p: An army deployment may need to extract itself from a contaminated environment. CBRN force protection is applied across three levels of capability:
list: Integral support: carried out at the personal level (for example, respirators and detectors) to ensure individual survival and continued support to the operation
Close support: maintains or restores operational tempo within a short period, beyond simple survival skills such as reconnaissance, surveillance and hazard avoidance
General support: thorough vehicle and equipment decontamination, plus sampling and identification

p: Weatherhaven provides full CBRN decontamination and protection, including mobile shelters and all the necessary systems. Militaries and humanitarian organizations can decontaminate equipment, vehicles, personnel and civilians, then take refuge in a clean and safe environment.
list: With special liners and air-filtration units added, the shelters can be used for decontamination, so medical personnel can treat patients exposed to toxic CBRN agents.
Softwall shelters use Chemical Agent Resistant Material (CARM) fabrics. Expandable shelters use Chemical Agent Resistant Coating (CARC) paint.
Everything needed for CBRN decontamination can be sourced and provided by Weatherhaven, from showers to berms, airlocks, recirc filters and decontaminant foam.
The solution minimizes water usage and captures washing, decontamination and rinsing fluids for disposal.

commercial/workforce.title: Workforce housing
commercial/workforce.lead: Portable shelters and shelter systems for mining, construction and exploration camps, used by mobile workforces in remote locations in more than 50 countries.

sections.h: No climate too harsh, no location too remote
p: Weatherhaven’s portable shelters and shelter systems provide comfort, safety and everyday convenience to mobile workforces in remote locations in more than 50 countries, from the Arctic Islands of Canada to the rain forests of Papua New Guinea.

Weatherhaven has spent the last 30 years designing, manufacturing and installing portable camps of all sizes for the resource industry. Happy workers are more productive, and attracting and retaining skilled labour is crucial. Fully functional living quarters, kitchens and washhouses keep your workforce comfortable and productive.

sections.h: A comfortable and safe camp is a requirement
p: Your camp, whether for mining, construction or exploration, is a significant investment and a visible indication of how you intend to conduct activities on site. A comfortable and safe workforce camp shows good faith to your customers, employees and other stakeholders.
list: Weatherhaven shelters are engineered to meet international codes and provisions for temporary workforce housing
Our team works with you to ensure a code-compliant camp and helps you obtain a certificate of occupancy

p: Transportation savings are built into the product and packaging design. Weatherhaven’s light, compact portable shelters are one-third the weight and one-seventh the volume of traditional trailer and modular camp alternatives. The result is significant transportation savings.

sections.h: Shipping to remote sites, including the Antarctic
p: Not all locations are accessible by road. Whether you are shipping by train, barge or aircraft such as a Twin Otter or Antonov, any project is feasible, however remote the setting.
Our team has extensive experience with freight transportation and international shipping documentation, and makes sure your shipment arrives on time and in the condition it left the factory.
Weatherhaven packaging is:
list: Custom manufactured to suit your transportation needs and meet international ISO shipping standards
Available in various heights, widths and lengths that can be lifted individually by helicopter, or linked together and transported anywhere by sea, rail, road or air

p: Weatherhaven structures need no special tools, site preparation or foundations, and no expert knowledge beyond general construction. Assembly is straightforward, with detailed instructions provided.
From initial camp and shelter design to shipping logistics and installation, our team handles all your workforce camp and portable shelter needs.

commercial/antarctic.title: Antarctic climate research
commercial/antarctic.lead: Weatherhaven’s product set has long contributed to climate change research in Antarctica. More than 20 of the 32 countries currently conducting climate change research there use Weatherhaven products.

p: Weatherhaven’s product set has long contributed to climate change research programs in Antarctica.

The shelters’ robust, thermally protective eco-design and ease of mobility make them well suited to scientific excursions on Antarctic and Arctic ice. That is why more than 20 of the 32 countries currently conducting climate change research in Antarctica use Weatherhaven products.
The eco-design also makes it one of the lowest carbon footprint shelter solutions on the planet.
From need assessment and shelter design to installation and equipment, Weatherhaven handles all your mobile shelter needs.

commercial/turnkey.lead: Turnkey camps that combine Weatherhaven shelters with camp layout and design, construction, and integrated camp systems such as power, water and waste management.

p: A growing part of Weatherhaven’s business is the provision of turnkey camps. These supply Weatherhaven shelter solutions and can also include:
list: Camp layout and design
Construction
Provision and integration of camp systems such as power, water and waste management

p: Weatherhaven has built a global network of supply chain partners that lets it support a client’s turnkey camp requirement quickly and competitively anywhere on the planet.
From need assessment and shelter design to installation and equipment, Weatherhaven handles all your mobile shelter needs.

commercial/luxury.title: Mobile luxury recreation container
commercial/luxury.lead: A fully equipped mobile retreat for all locations and climates, including hot desert. It ships as a 20-foot ISO container, the MECC, and is set up by two people in 20–30 minutes.

sections.h: Comfort in any location and climate
p: Weatherhaven’s mobile luxury recreation container delivers comfort and style in all locations and climates around the world, including extreme conditions such as the hot desert.
The container brings the comfort of home to you and is equipped with:
list: High-end kitchen appliances and designer pieces
A fully equipped bathroom
High-end finishing
A complete bedroom with a wardrobe and a queen-sized bed
Wireless communication and entertainment, including a high-definition television, surround-sound system, entertainment centre and lighting, all controlled by touchscreen from a tablet or phone

p: High-quality thermal insulation delivers comfort across a wide range of temperatures, from -48°C to 55°C.

Each wall panel has three layers: an insulating layer, a custom panel with a transparent layer so you can enjoy the view while holding the inside temperature, and netting to let air move. With all three layers rolled up, the outdoor seating area connects to the internal entertainment system for a seamless indoor/outdoor area.
The container includes an Arabic-style outdoor seating area with a stone fire pit powered by gas or firewood. An outdoor hoist and hose bib are included for skinning, slaughtering and cleaning game.

A Murphy-style hot-and-cold Jacuzzi tub is supported by pneumatic arms and sets up in one minute with one hand. It seats three to four people and has jets, with external speakers connected to the indoor sound system.

An additional container provides support services, such as power generation and distribution, and storage. It protects furniture during shipment, houses drinking water and wastewater, and powers hot- and cold-water distribution.
The luxury recreation container is transported as a 20-foot ISO shipping container: the MECC three-in-one expandable container, which two people set up in 20–30 minutes.
Weatherhaven works with you to design and deliver a customized, one-of-a-kind mobile retreat.

services/engineering.title: Engineering and design
services/engineering.lead: From product configurations and drawings to interoperability analysis, Weatherhaven’s engineering and design teams work with you to create a mobile shelter solution that meets your requirements.

p: Whether you manage a workforce camp or lead a military or medical operation, your mobile shelter requirements are as specific as your project. They may be as basic as a single portable shelter or as involved as an integrated turnkey camp.
From product configurations and drawings to interoperability analysis, our engineering and design teams work with you to create a custom mobile shelter solution.

Weatherhaven runs an active and intensive research and development (R&D) program to update existing products and develop new shelter solutions. It has produced numerous specialty shelters for defence and industry, including:
list: MEX-26, a first-line and second-line maintenance shelter

The patented Mobile Expandable Container Configuration (MECC), a hybrid design that combines Weatherhaven’s proven fabric technology with the world’s first standard in transportation, the ISO container
MTS-3 Modular Tentage System, which combines the best features of the Weatherhaven softwall product line and is the world’s most versatile tactical soft shelter
Extended Height MECC (EHMECC)
Tactical Redeployable Expanding Container Capability (TRECC), a two-pallet-position CH-47-deployed shelter
The patented Hardwall Expandable Redeployable Container (HERCon), for semi-permanent accommodation
Tactical floors
Solarshades

p: Weatherhaven designs typically start as a practical response to an actual requirement, drawing on the company’s collective experience for preliminary concepts. The design then moves through these stages:
list: Preliminary concepts
Design engineering and analysis
Field trials for prototype verification (larger programs)
Production
Custom product development
Product configurations and drawings
Transport packaging
Product performance specifications
Interoperability analysis
Integrated Logistics Support (ILS)

services/logistics.title: Transportation and logistics
services/logistics.lead: Weatherhaven shelters are designed for transport to remote locations, and its logistics team handles international shipping and documentation. A fabric camp with space for 96 beds ships in one 20-foot container.

p: Timelines, routing, tracking, security and documentation are critical to keeping your project on track. Weatherhaven’s logistics team has years of experience in international shipping and documentation, and makes sure your equipment is packaged properly and delivered on time.

Transportation efficiencies are built into the product and packaging design. All Weatherhaven portable shelters are designed for ease of transport to remote locations around the world, from Farnham Glacier to Peru. The result is significant transportation savings and on-time delivery.

Whether you are shipping by train, barge or aircraft such as a Twin Otter or Antonov, Weatherhaven can help you get your equipment to site, however remote or harsh the setting. Weatherhaven packaging is:
list: Customized to suit your transportation needs, from bulk-packed containers to person-portable bags, shrink-wrapped and crated
Available in various heights, widths and lengths that can be lifted individually by helicopter, or transported anywhere by sea, rail, road or air
The fabric camp is one-third the weight and one-seventh the volume of a modular building camp. Space for 96 beds can be shipped in one 20-foot shipping container.
The transportation footprint of the expandable containers ranges from one-fifth to one-third of the camp footprint.
Shelters ship from any of Weatherhaven’s global facilities, all close to major seaports, highways, international airports and railways.

services/installation.title: Installation and dismantling
services/installation.lead: Shelters and shelter systems engineered for quick set-up and dismantling through prefabrication and quick-connect electrical, mechanical and furnishing components. Weatherhaven can supply supervisors and a full workforce, or supervisors to work with your personnel.

p: Weatherhaven’s portable shelters and shelter systems are engineered for quick, straightforward set-up and dismantling. This is made possible through prefabrication and quick-connect methods for electrical, mechanical and furnishing components.
The choice depends on your operational needs and budget:
list: Weatherhaven supervisors and a workforce to handle the full installation
Weatherhaven supervisors working directly with your personnel
Easy-to-follow operation and maintenance manuals, provided for every job
For more complex applications, Weatherhaven manages part or all of the set-up and dismantling process
Demobilization and relocation of camps to the next project site

p: Weatherhaven’s installation supervisors serve clients quickly and efficiently. Crew members are chosen for skill, character, work ethic, experience, and the ability to go anywhere, anytime.
Crews are familiar with a variety of terrain and environments, from extreme polar latitudes to equatorial regions. They include world-class mountaineers and expedition leaders.

list: An installation team experienced in setting up shelters and shelter systems in remote locations with little or no existing infrastructure
Shelters that are efficiently installed, structurally sound and ready for use
Custom training programs to help you set up and maintain your shelters, at Weatherhaven facilities, your own site or in the field
Shipping from any of Weatherhaven’s global facilities, all close to major seaports, highways, international airports and railways

services/training.title: Training and in-service support
services/training.lead: Custom training packages and in-service support to help you set up and maintain Weatherhaven shelters and shelter systems, and keep new and existing equipment in service for decades.

p: With current budget cuts, companies and governments at home and abroad are fiscally conscious. The mandate is to maintain and support both new and existing equipment to get the most longevity from products, for decades at a time.
To help you set up and maintain your Weatherhaven portable shelters and shelter systems, Weatherhaven provides custom training packages based on your requirements.
Training typically consists of a classroom session followed by a hands-on field exercise. It can also include printed and soft-copy manuals.
Training can take place at Weatherhaven facilities, at your own site, or in the field where you set up and use the products.
Weatherhaven provides:
list: Preventive and corrective maintenance packages
A Train the Trainer program
A Field Service Representative (FSR) who either makes site visits or lives in the camp at all times

services/repair.title: Repair and overhaul
services/repair.lead: Weatherhaven inspects, repairs, overhauls and upgrades shelters and shelter systems to the latest standard, so they are ready for future deployments.

p: Repair and overhaul keeps your mobile shelters and shelter systems as good as new and ready for future deployments. Weatherhaven staff inspect your shelters and systems and, where required, carry out a complete repair and overhaul to upgrade them to the latest standard.

In accordance with Canada’s A-LM-184-00/JS-001 publication for R&O contractors, Weatherhaven’s in-service support facility provides repair and overhaul services for a variety of softwall and MECC shelters.
Repair and overhaul also covers associated shelter systems, including refrigeration and HVAC units. Common functions include:
list: Handling
Repairs
Overhauls
Modifications
Conversions
Upgrades
Storage
Equipment configuration management
Technical data management
Integrated Logistics Support (ILS)
Maintenance support
The equipment is shipped to Weatherhaven or a subsidiary
Weatherhaven inspects it and creates a deficiency list
Repairs and upgrades are carried out according to the maximum repair cost (MRC) value, with approval sought for repairs above the MRC
The equipment is returned to you in serviceable condition, in its latest configuration

p: The life cycle of equipment maintained through a repair and overhaul contract is extended indefinitely. Equipment is repaired, overhauled and upgraded to the latest standard, keeping it current for as long as the client wishes.
This has proven a very cost-effective way for the military to keep deployable camps, medical facilities and other shelter-based capability in a constant state of readiness.

services/parts.title: Parts

list: Frame components
Cover systems
Electrical kits
Backup generators

support/ablutions.title: Ablutions and washhouses
support/ablutions.lead: From a single bathroom within a shelter to a complete facility with toilets, sinks and showers, for commercial, military and medical operations.

p: Whether it is a single bathroom within a shelter or a complete facility with toilets, sinks and showers, ablutions and washhouses are an essential component of any mobile commercial, military or medical operation.
Weatherhaven’s ablutions and washhouses:
list: Are custom designed to your specifications
Feature interior design details and finishes that support hygiene and housekeeping
Include lightweight, durable furnishings, from sinks, toilets and urinals to showers and washtubs
Contain comprehensive electrical and mechanical components and water-management systems, such as reverse-osmosis water systems, storage bladders and water-distribution units
Link with corridors, laundry or accommodations
Can be tactical or semi-permanent, depending on the deployment

support/kitchens.title: Kitchens
support/kitchens.lead: Redeployable mobile kitchens, from a single tactical kitchen to a full-service kitchen that feeds 1,000 people three fresh meals a day.

p: Weatherhaven manufactured the MSVS Kitchen for the Department of National Defence, an army kitchen capable of feeding 500 people at once. It received one of the best final reviews possible during trials at the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) Connaught Range Primary Training Centre.

“It’s an awesome sight to see the [MSVS] fully equipped and deployed. I couldn’t believe what the engineers put the kitchen through during testing, but that’s the proof of durability,” said WO Stephane Charron. Lieutenant-Colonel Julie Johnson added, “This kitchen looks like one designed by cooks!”

Whether it is a single tactical kitchen or a full-service kitchen that feeds 1,000 people three fresh meals a day, Weatherhaven designs and manufactures redeployable mobile kitchens for camp occupants, soldiers and humanitarians in remote areas around the world.

Tactical or portable kitchens often use Weatherhaven’s expandable container format, where equipment can be hard-mounted in the core for rapid set-up on site and protection during transport. Larger camp kitchens are often housed in the Series 4 fabric shelter, which is also used for dining rooms.
Weatherhaven’s redeployable portable kitchens:
list: Range from small self-serve facilities to full-service kitchens, housed in fabric shelters, expandable containers or a combination of both, that can feed three fresh meals a day to a camp of 500 people or more
Offer complete capability for food preparation, cooking, baking, broiling, frying and wash-up
Feature rugged interiors with top-of-the-line furnishings to maintain a high standard of health and sanitation
Can be equipped with an integrated fire-suppression system and full electrical and mechanical interfaces for medium- to long-term food service on field deployments
Can link with related facilities, such as dining halls, cold storage or pantries, using interconnectors and corridors

facts: 1,000 people, three fresh meals a day
Three fresh meals a day for 500 people or more

support/laundry.title: Laundry
support/laundry.lead: Redeployable batch and self-serve field laundry for 250 to 500 people, fully operational in less than one hour once connected to power, water and effluent catchment.

sections.h: Full laundry capability, from batch to self-serve
p: Whether you are running a field hospital or living in a camp, clean linens and a fully functional laundry facility are a necessity for both comfort and sanitation.
Weatherhaven’s field laundry capability can be deployed worldwide and comes with the equipment you need:
list: Batch laundry: large commercial drying tumblers and stainless-steel washer/extractors with solid-state, field-programmable, micro-computing controls. The controls handle motor logic, a selection of cycles and speeds, and diagnostics.
Self-serve laundry: stackable washers and dryers for individual use

p: The integrated mechanical room allows the laundry shelter to be fully operational in less than one hour once connected to a power and water source and effluent catchment.
Weatherhaven’s redeployable field laundry capability:
list: Can support the laundry of 250 to 500 people, depending on staffing
Can include an integrated mechanical room for stand-alone operation
Has a rugged interior and exterior for maximum service life with minimal maintenance
Includes comprehensive electrical and mechanical support systems
Uses a water-saving system to reduce water consumption, when needed
Has interior design details and stainless-steel finishes that support hygiene and housekeeping

p: Common batch-laundry and self-serve laundry configurations include:
list: Washer/extractor (with water-reclamation system)
Drying tumbler
Dryer air inlet duct (or plenum)
Grey-water tank
Mechanical/service room
Water-pressure pump
Folding tables
Heaters
Electrical service panel

facts: Less than 1 hour once connected to power, water and effluent catchment

support/sleeping.title: Sleeping quarters
support/sleeping.lead: Climate-controlled sleeping quarters for workforces, soldiers and humanitarians, in Series 4, Series 8 and MTS softwall shelters or the HERCon hardwall expandable container.

sections.h: Quality sleep is required for performance
p: Inadequate sleep is known to impair cognitive capacities such as attention and concentration. Quick, decisive action is often needed to perform your duties, which means staying alert throughout the day. Comfortable sleeping quarters are a necessity.
Weatherhaven designs and manufactures climate-controlled sleeping quarters that provide rest, comfort and security to workforces, soldiers and humanitarians stationed around the world.
The Series 4, Series 8 and MTS softwall shelters are commonly used as accommodation units. They can be fully or partially insulated and have many door, window, floor and electrical options.

The HERCon, Weatherhaven’s hardwall expandable container, is another popular accommodation shelter. It can be designed with living quarters such as a kitchen and a full bathroom with toilet, sink and shower.
Accommodation shelters can be configured to house one or several people, including dormitory-style sleepers with bunk beds.
Along with the shelters, Weatherhaven can supply all the furnishings you need, such as:
list: Night tables
Beds
Mattresses
Lockers and closets

support/floors.title: Floors
support/floors.lead: A large selection of flooring for any terrain and shelter application, from tactical floors for frequent relocation to economical floors for long-term deployments.

sections.h: Custom flooring for any application or terrain
p: Weatherhaven offers a large selection of flooring to complement your shelters and suit your operational needs. The type of flooring recommended depends on:
list: The intended application
Geographical location
Site terrain
Your budget
Your redeployment and relocation needs

p: Weatherhaven flooring is designed to function on any terrain and for all mobile shelter applications:
list: Long-term deployments: economical floor systems that are compact and cost-effective to ship and store
Short-term projects and frequent relocation: tactical floor systems for rapid set-up and straightforward deployment
Levelling devices for easy set-up on uneven ground
Anti-static, slip-resistant, hygienic tile flooring for a number of applications, including medical
Reinforced steel or aluminum checker-plate flooring for workshops with heavy equipment

support/emw.title: Electrical, mechanical and water
support/emw.lead: Pre-assembled electrical kits, custom-designed mechanical systems and water systems, shipped with or integrated into Weatherhaven shelters.

p: Weatherhaven’s pre-assembled electrical kits, either shipped with or integrated into your shelters, are designed for safety, convenience, performance, durability and ease of installation. Weatherhaven can provide:
list: A variety of electrical systems, from basic lights and panels for accommodation units to high-amperage, heavy-duty systems for large kitchen complexes
Custom-designed systems for extremely hot or cold environments
Electrical kits designed and certified to meet code requirements for on-site use
Various voltages, frequencies and hardware to meet user requirements worldwide
Technical solutions for complex requirements, such as laboratories, large camps, or field hospitals for disaster relief and peacekeeping

p: Mechanical systems vary with the intended application, scope and size of your facility. They range from individual heaters, hot-water tanks, ventilation kits and basic plumbing to water purification, medical-waste incinerators and sewage treatment.
list: Most Weatherhaven mechanical systems are custom designed
Systems are durable, robust and easily redeployable, suited to facilities that are installed, dismantled and moved frequently
Mechanical systems can be housed in a mechanical room or integrated into the centre core of the MECC or HERCon, for maximum performance in a limited space

p: Weatherhaven provides water systems designed to user needs, from simple filtration systems to more capable and complex ROWPU units.

Central generator for the camp

support/mobilizers.title: Mobilizers and trailers
support/mobilizers.lead: Mobilizers and trailers to move the EHMECC, MECC and TRECC, including the LH55 ISO Container Mobilizer and the Mobility Trailer. The containers stay fully functional when deployed on either.

p: Along with its expandable containers, Weatherhaven can source and supply support vehicles such as mobilizers and trailers to transport the EHMECC, MECC and TRECC, for a complete turnkey solution. The Mobilizer:
list: Has all-terrain capability
Travels at up to 55 mph (89 km/h) in its high-speed version
Has a flexible design and robust construction
Has adjustable ends for ground clearance, which suits loading containers onto aircraft
Converts from a low-speed to a high-speed unit by adding vehicle accessories
Carries expandable containers that are fully functional when deployed on it, with side extensions available to support the expandable sides

p: Weatherhaven designed the LH55 (low/high-speed) ISO Container Mobilizer as a cost-effective, low-speed container mover that can be upgraded for high-speed duty. Conversion is done by adding full fenders, mud flaps and a 24 VDC lighting system, which lets the LH55 travel at 55 mph (89 km/h).

The LH55 moves containers from one location to another on rough terrain or paved highway. It has a gross vehicle weight of 29,500 lb (13,381 kg) and provides towed transport for 10 ft (3 m) or 20 ft (6 m) ISO containers weighing up to 24,000 lb (10,886 kg).

Each end is independently adjustable to give ground clearance up to 32 in (81 cm), for loading containers onto aircraft. The LH55 was initially designed for airfield operations. Its flexible design and robust construction give it all-terrain capability.

The MECC, EHMECC and TRECC can be deployed while still attached to the Mobilizer and be fully functional. Side extensions support the expandable sides when the shelter is deployed on the Mobilizer, and levelling jacks allow set-up on uneven terrain.

Armed forces need to move equipment over varied terrain, from modern highways to contour-hugging secondary roads, rugged off-road conditions and detours that may involve river fording. Moving heavy container cargo over these surfaces needs a vehicle that can withstand highway speeds, anti-racking stresses, irregular surfaces and water submersion.

The Mobility Trailer does this, with highway speeds of 55 mph (89 km/h) and off-road speeds of 15 mph (24 km/h). Loaded, it is designed to be towed by military 5-ton vehicles such as the FMTV cargo truck used by US Forces, making it a simple solution for any MECC or ISO container movement in the armed forces.
list: Configured for a 20 ft (6 m) MECC, which is fully functional when deployed on the trailer with the support of side extensions
Standard ISO connectors
Ruggedized for serious off-road conditions
Heavy-duty I-beam construction
Tandem axle, dual wheel
Air brakes and emergency breakaway braking
24 V electrical system with NATO-standard connectors
Blackout and standard lighting
Levelling capability for uneven terrain

p: The 7.5T Mobility Trailer is designed to transport the MECC, a 3-in-1 expandable container that is a 20 ft (6 m) ISO-certified container in its shipping configuration. The trailer’s integral levelling lets the MECC be fully deployed while mounted on it. This has led to the acquisition of many dedicated Mobility Trailer/MECC systems for operations that need immediate mobilization and relocation.

facts: 10 ft (3 m) or 20 ft (6 m) ISO

support/security.title: Security
support/security.lead: Force-protection barriers, high-security perimeter or electric fencing, and lighting towers for Weatherhaven turnkey military camps, procured through Weatherhaven’s partner network and global supply chain.

p: To safeguard people, property and equipment, Weatherhaven’s turnkey military camps can be supplied with force-protection barriers, high-security perimeter or electric fencing, and lighting towers. All are procured directly through Weatherhaven’s network of partners and global supply chain.
Weatherhaven can provide ground-mounted, redeployable security fences or electric-fence deterrents.

A typical high-security perimeter fence is approximately 2.5 metres high, with three-strand razor wire and barbed coil. A heavy-duty, industrial-grade fence with double gates on either side of the camp or compound provides security and controls entry and egress of personnel and equipment.

Weatherhaven can also source and provide lighting towers and defensive barriers for your military camp. Sourced from a range of manufacturers, defensive barriers provide the security, structural integrity and strength needed to protect against gunfire, weapons and other security threats.
Weatherhaven’s team assists through each stage of military camp deployment, from initial shelter design to installation and post-project support.

facts: Three-strand razor wire and barbed coil
Double gates on either side of the camp

accessories/solarshade.title: Solarshade
accessories/solarshade.lead: Solarshades are used with Weatherhaven shelters in areas of extreme, direct solar radiation. They give 70 percent shade coverage and block 95 percent of UV rays.

p: Whether you are stationed in Mozambique or Afghanistan, extreme heat and a high UV index create challenges and health issues for camp occupants: rising temperature-control costs, heat-related injuries to personnel, and wear and tear on your shelters.

Weatherhaven Solarshades are used with your shelter for protection in areas of extreme, direct solar radiation. All Weatherhaven shelters are made from high-grade, UV-resistant fabrics. The Solarshade further reduces exposure to harmful radiation, extending the life of your shelter and increasing worker productivity and comfort.
The Weatherhaven Solarshade:
list: Protects against harmful UV rays, with high UV resistance and 70 percent shade coverage
Reduces air conditioning requirements, so AC units can be smaller. This in turn reduces generator size, cuts the fuel to be transported and reduces casualties from transporting fuel in hostile areas
Blocks 95 percent of UV rays
Is breathable, with 12-inch ventilation holes that reduce wind-induced lift and improve air circulation
Reduces demands on climate-control systems, for significant fuel-cost savings
Is made from fire-retardant material
Is rot and mould/mildew resistant
Provides high tensile strength in the warp and weft directions
Is easy to set up
Is available in six standard colours

accessories/interconnectors.title: Interconnectors and corridors
accessories/interconnectors.lead: Interconnectors and corridors link Weatherhaven shelters into a complex, so occupants and equipment move between shelters protected from the weather and, in tactical situations, from visual observation.

p: Weatherhaven interconnectors link Weatherhaven shelters and provide a weather-resistant interior environment. They add safety, security and comfort throughout the complex by protecting personnel from the elements and, in tactical situations, from visual observation. Interconnectors:
list: Link shelters to one another or to corridors to form a complex
Enlarge a specific-purpose area without replacing the entire shelter
Connect related areas, such as an operating room and central sterile supply
Offer waterproof, fire-retardant, ultraviolet-stabilized and blackout cover material options
Offer many options for doors, flooring and insulation to suit different types of deployment
Let occupants travel between shelters without going outside

p: In medical applications such as a field hospital, interconnectors can be vital: they keep patients, staff and sensitive medical equipment out of the outside weather. In less critical applications, they add comfort and convenience, for example when connecting kitchen and dining areas, or dormitories and ablution units.

Interconnectors are made in a number of lengths for maximum flexibility in camp layout. They can link as few as two buildings or an entire camp. An existing system can grow by adding shelters, and a shelter can be removed from a larger site without dismantling or disrupting the whole complex.

Interconnectors interface with all Weatherhaven modular shelters, including the MTS and MECC. The MECC and MTS can be linked end-to-end or side-to-side, whichever suits the configuration. Custom configurations are available in addition to these standard sizes (width × length):
list: MTS/MECC: 4 ft (1.2 m) × 6 ft (1.8 m)
MECC/MECC: 4 ft (1.2 m) × 4 ft (1.2 m)
MECC end/MECC side: 7 ft (2.1 m) × 12 ft (3.7 m)
MECC side/MECC side: 7 ft (2.1 m) × 2 ft (0.6 m)
MECC end/MECC end: 7 ft (2.1 m) × 5 ft (1.5 m)
Various cover configurations and finishes
Hard door or fabric door entry/exit points
Insulated or non-insulated
Floor systems: various hard and fabric floors

p: Weatherhaven corridors are protected passageways that shield occupants from the elements as they travel between shelters in a camp. Besides connecting shelter facilities, corridors provide additional work and living areas for personnel. Corridors:
list: Allow a variety of camp layout configurations
Provide additional work or relaxation areas
Allow access to various shelters from a central corridor
Provide a weather-resistant interior environment
Protect occupants and equipment from visual observation
Connect related areas, such as kitchen and dining
Offer waterproof, fire-retardant, ultraviolet-stabilized and blackout cover material options
Let occupants travel between shelters without facing outside weather conditions

p: Corridors that connect related shelters, such as kitchen and dining facilities, can serve as additional serving areas. They can also be used for relaxation during breaks, so personnel do not interfere with work areas. In operational situations, corridors protect personnel and equipment from visual observation while providing a weather-resistant environment.
Weatherhaven offers both hardwall and softwall corridors. The softwall corridor can be made in the same fabrics and finishes as Weatherhaven shelters.

The container corridor combines purpose-built ISO shipping containers that can also be used to transport shelters and equipment. Each ISO container is linked to an interconnector, which is attached to the next ISO container to form a corridor. This makes use of the containers the camp was shipped in and reduces the need for storage space.
Weatherhaven also manufactures an Arctic Corridor so that Series 4 shelters can be joined to a central passageway.

Vestibules, including weather air locks and blackout breezeways, can be used in flooring, hardwall options and partitions. Alongside interconnectors, they provide the link between the entryway and larger complexes such as hospitals.
